name: Okaa-san wa Ore Sen'you! ~Anata no Hajimete o... Okaa-san ga Moratte A-ge-ru~
original_name: お母さんは俺専用！～あなたの初めてを…母さんが貰ってア・ゲ・ル～
source:
Kousei flunk his university entrance exam. Prep-school did not help much because he does not like to study to begin with. He is living alone trying to be independent and works a few days a week to support his financial needs. But such work only makes him nothing more than a half-NEET.

Yuiko, the youthfully energetic mother of Kousei, always comes by to help with household chores and provide moral support. Just like the good mother she is, she's concerned about her son's status so she hired a personal tutor to help Kousei enter a university. He is bewildered at first that Yuiko hired her own self. Yayoi, a co-worker of Yuiko in the same tutoring company, is also hired.

Now begins the tutorial...but it seems like Kousei wants to "learn" something else as well.

[Edited from KAORI Nusantara]
translation:
木下考正大学入学考试落榜。预备校也没起多大作用，因为他本来就不喜欢学习。他独居并试图独立，每周打几天工维持生活，但这种工作只让他沦为半个尼特族。

考正年轻而精力充沛的母亲优衣子，总会过来帮忙做家务，并给予精神支持。就像一名好母亲会做的那样，她担心儿子的处境，于是请了一名私人家教，帮助考正考上大学。起初，他很困惑优衣子竟雇用了她自己。优衣子在同一家家教公司工作的弥生，也受聘前来。

现在，辅导开始了……但考正似乎还想「学习」别的东西。

[改编自KAORI Nusantara]
